headline: DET @ NYY matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is DET 3.38 at NYY 3.56, with a projected total of 6.94. Movement read: Both offenses moved down (DET -0.83, NYY -0.70), so the movement points more toward run suppression than a clearer side. The projected total fell -1.53, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +17.3%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Cam Schlittler has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Kevin McGonigle, Spencer Torkelson, Hao-Yu Lee, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Ben Rice, Austin Wells because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
